records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_compare_dialog.MeasurementComparePanel.apply_workspace_state#1
records.source: Recognized, correctly typed entries are applied independently. Unknown fixed choices are ignored; measurement and class identifiers that are not yet offered remain pending until an ordinary refresh or data update. No new join, file read or inference starts. The cached comparison and figure remain unchanged until the next refresh.
